name: plan-orchestrator
description: The route skill staffs every stage of a long Claude Code plan (split, executor, model, check), tracks progress on a board, and picks up from the board after Claude Code compacts.

board_location.title: Board location
board_location.description: Where the route skill keeps its progress board: a file in the project (default PROGRESS.md), or a platform as command:<read command> ;; <write command> [;; <write command> ...], e.g. command:gh project item-list ;; gh project item-edit ;; gh project item-add

board_fields.title: Board fields
board_fields.description: Comma-separated fields for each board row. Status always uses Todo, In Progress, Needs Verification, Done, Blocked.
